title: Vanilla Cord Logger
body:
Vanilla Cord Logger is a lightweight, no-frills Minecraft mod that lets you save your coordinates instantly without cluttering your screen.

Press the keybind and the mod will log your current position (X, Y, Z) into a .txt file automatically created on your desktop. Each press records where you were standing at that moment, making it easy to keep track of bases, caves, structures, or any important locations.

Designed to feel as vanilla as possible, this mod avoids on-screen waypoints, minimaps, or HUD elements. It’s perfect if you want a simple coord logger without breaking immersion or constantly writing coordinates down by hand.

Features:

One-key coordinate logging (Home key)

Automatically creates a .txt file on your desktop

Clean, readable coordinate entries

No UI clutter, waypoints, or extra overlays

Simple and lightweight vanilla-friendly design

**disclaimer**
This mod does create a .txt file on your PC. 
This mod does NOT in any way harm your device.
The file created can be modified and/or deleted by the user at any time.
